title: Fake CBI officer: money laundering (Hinglish)
label: scam
notes: Based on the common pattern reported in news: Aadhaar linked to a money laundering case, victim kept on video call, asked to move savings to an 'RBI verification account'.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello, kya main Sharma ji se baat kar raha hoon?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Main Inspector Vikram Singh, CBI Delhi headquarters se bol raha hoon.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aapke Aadhaar card se ek bank account khula hai jo money laundering case mein use hua hai.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Kya? Maine toh aisa kuch nahi kiya sir.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aapke naam pe FIR darj ho chuki hai aur arrest warrant nikal chuka hai.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Ab aap digital arrest mein hain. Video call pe camera on rakhiye, room se bahar mat jaiye.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yeh national security ka matter hai, kisi ko bhi mat batana, family ko bhi nahi.

lines.speaker: user
lines.text: Theek hai sir, main kisi ko nahi bataunga.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Agar aap cooperate nahi karenge toh 2 ghante mein local police team aapke ghar aa jayegi.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Aapke bank account mein kitna balance hai? Account details bataiye.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Verification ke liye saare paise RBI ke safe account mein transfer karne honge. Jaanch ke baad refund ho jayega.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Abhi turant RTGS kariye, warna aapko jail jaana padega.
